jobs.title: Software Engineer I - Backend (Kirana Club)
jobs.description:
**About The Team**
We're a small engineering team, so scope is wide and ownership is real. You'll ship to production in your first week, and every
  
  
week after that.
  
  
Every engineering role here is back-end-leaning fullstack. Most of your time goes into services, data models and APIs, but you
  
  
own your work all the way to the screen — and the screen should look like someone cared. If frontend hasn't been your main
  
  
thing, that gap is far smaller than it used to be. What we can't teach is taste: the sense of what a good interface feels like, and
  
  
the instinct to notice when something is confusing, slow or ugly before a user has to tell you.
  
  
Everyone here writes code with LLMs — Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, whatever works, on the paid tier, and we don't count
  
  
tokens. Producing code is cheap now, so what we hire for is judgment, verification, specification and taste. One hard rule: you
  
  
own every line you ship, whether you typed it or not. "The model wrote it" is not an explanation in code review, in a
  
  
postmortem, or in a design discussion.
  
  
**About The Role**
This is a backend-leaning fullstack role, and a high-volume learning one. You'll build and ship features end to end — from the
  
  
data model through the API to the screen someone actually uses — writing a lot of code and getting a lot of reviews. You'll be
  
  
trusted with production early and work on real problems from your first week. The goal for your first year is simple: to become
  
  
someone the team can hand an ambiguous problem to.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Build and ship well-scoped features end to end, including the data model, the API, and the interface that consumes it.
* Deploy to production several times a week, starting with small changes and growing into larger ones.
* Debug production issues by reading logs, traces and stack traces, and get to the root cause rather than to a workaround.
* Build the frontend for the features you own — clean, usable, with the loading, empty and error states actually handled

rather than left for later.
  
  

* Write tests that would genuinely catch the bug you're worried about.
* Participate in code review on both sides: have your work critiqued, and learn to critique others'.
* Ask questions early and often. Being stuck quietly for a day is the only real mistake here.

**What We're Looking For**

* At least 1 year of full-time experience.
* Strong fundamentals in at least one programming language. We don't mind which.
* Working knowledge of SQL and relational data modelling.
* Comfort building a working, decent-looking interface for what you build. You don't need to have been a frontend engineer,

but you should be able to tell good UI from bad and care about the difference.
  
  

* Evidence that you've built something real and finished it — a project with actual users, a substantial internship

contribution, or an open-source PR that survived review.
  
  

* Debugging instinct: when something breaks, you form a hypothesis instead of changing things at random.
* Comfort using AI coding tools, and equal comfort being asked to explain any line of the output.

**Our Stack**
Go, Python and Node/TypeScript on the backend. React, Next.js and React Native on the client.
  
  
We pick the language that fits the problem rather than standardising for its own sake, so expect to work in more than one of
  
  
these and to learn at least one of them here. Framework experience is not a filter — we hire for the ability to pick things up,
  
  
and most people are productive in an unfamiliar part of this stack within a few weeks.

jobs.description:
**Falcon**
is the optimizing just in time (JIT) compiler in Azul Platform Prime. It compiles hot Java bytecode into highly optimized machine code and delivers Java performance that standard JVMs do not reach. Falcon is built on LLVM.

  

We are looking for a
**Compiler Performance Engineer**
to make Falcon generate even faster code. This is not a compiler front end role and not a compiler built from scratch: the compiler exists, runs in production at large enterprises, and your job is to find where the generated code is slower than it should be and fix it in the optimizer and code generator.

  

You will join a distributed team of compiler experts and work on real workloads with direct, measurable impact on customer performance.

**What You Will Do (aka Responsibilities)**
  

  
* Analyze performance of Java benchmarks and customer workloads, find gaps in generated code and trace them to their root cause in the compiler
  
* Implement and improve optimizations in Falcon's middle end and back end: inlining, loop optimizations, vectorization, redundancy elimination, speculative optimizations and their interaction with the runtime
  
* Improve code generation for x86\_64 and AArch64
  
* Write tests and benchmarks that prove the improvement and protect it from regressions
  
* Contribute changes upstream to LLVM where it makes sense
  

  
**What You'll Bring (Experience, Skills)**
  

  
* 2+ years of professional experience in compilers, JIT compilers or low level performance engineering
  
* Strong C++ design and coding skills
  
* Solid understanding of compiler optimization theory: SSA, data flow analysis, loop transformations
  
* Ability to read assembly and reason about why one instruction sequence is faster than another
  

  
**Very Nice to Have**
  

  
* Experience with LLVM IR and LLVM optimization passes, or with another optimizing compiler such as HotSpot C2, Graal, GCC or V8
  
* Experience with profilers such as perf, VTune or async profiler
  
* Knowledge of x86\_64 and/or AArch64 microarchitecture

jobs.description:
**About us**
------------

Bolna is a voice AI platform: businesses build agents that hold real phone and web conversations in English and Indian languages, at scale. Every call runs a live pipeline of speech-to-text, an LLM and text-to-speech over telephony, and the backend around it handles dispatch, billing, analytics and evaluation.

**Experience:** 2-3 years

We're looking for a hands-on backend engineer who wants to work where APIs meet real-time voice. You'll build and own features across our backend and the voice agent pipeline: the APIs customers call, the systems that place and track calls, and the speech and LLM integrations that make a conversation sound natural. You'll turn loosely defined problems, often a single bad call, into reliable fixes in production, and follow through on how they perform. You use AI coding tools every day and can explain, test and debug the code you ship.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Backend**

* Build and maintain the APIs, databases and background workers behind live calls.
* Own features end to end: clarify requirements, make trade-offs, deploy, monitor, and fix in production.

### **Voice AI**

* Integrate and tune speech-to-text, text-to-speech and LLM providers (for example Deepgram, Sarvam, Azure, ElevenLabs, OpenAI) inside the real-time call pipeline.
* Work on telephony and web calling: provider callbacks (Twilio, Plivo, SIP), WebSocket audio streaming, call status, recordings and transfers.
* Improve conversation quality: latency, interruptions, multilingual agents and language switching, voicemail and hangup handling.
* Debug individual calls from transcripts, traces and logs, find the root cause, and turn it into a fix with a test.
* Help build evaluation tooling (LLM-as-judge metrics, call replays, golden sets) that tells us whether a change made calls better or worse.

### **How you work**

* Use AI coding tools to explore the codebase, draft implementations, write tests and debug. Review and validate what they produce before it ships.
* Work with a small team to scope releases, raise blockers early, and adapt as priorities change.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 2-3 years of backend engineering, building and running APIs in production.
* Working knowledge of SQL databases and automated testing.
* Some hands-on exposure to voice or conversational AI: you have built or worked on a voice bot, a speech-to-text or text-to-speech integration, an LLM agent, or a real-time audio or WebSocket service.
* A basic grasp of how a voice agent works: the speech-to-text, LLM and text-to-speech loop, and why latency and turn-taking matter.
* Experience using Git and debugging backend issues through logs, metrics or traces.
* Regular use of AI coding tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code or Codex, with examples of how you verify their output.
* A track record of ownership: you can describe a feature or production issue you drove to resolution, the decisions you made, and what happened after release.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience with telephony (Twilio, Plivo, Exotel, SIP) or WebRTC.
* Familiarity with audio basics: sample rates, codecs such as mu-law and PCM, streaming and buffering.
* Experience with multilingual or Indian-language speech (Hindi, Tamil and others), language detection, or code-switched conversations.
* Experience evaluating LLM output: prompt iteration, LLM-as-judge metrics, or regression sets.
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD, or deploying services on AWS.
* Experience with Redis, message queues, background jobs, third-party webhooks, or API performance tuning.
* Experience with observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog) or analytics stores such as ClickHouse.
* Experience working on a small team at a fast-paced startup.

jobs.description:
### **BI Analyst / BI Developer – Power BI, SQL & DAX (Remote, India)**

Gusti Leder is a German brand for natural leather goods, with retail stores in Germany and Austria, an online shop, and teams across Europe and India. We want every team—from the CEO to store managers—to make decisions from fast, clear, and trustworthy dashboards.

We are looking for our first dedicated BI specialist: someone who understands what colleagues really need from their data, helps us choose the right BI platform, builds a solid data model, and delivers dashboards people actually use.

### **What Matters Most to Us**

* **Numbers You Can Trust:** Totals that reconcile with our source systems, clear KPI definitions, and checks that catch problems before management does.
* **Understanding the Goal Behind a Request:** You look beyond the written requirement, understand how colleagues want to work with the data, and suggest better ways to answer their question.
* **Business Sense:** You think about cost, speed, and how a dashboard looks to a busy CEO—not only about the technology.
* **Ownership:** You take a report from requirement to rollout and keep it running.

### **Why Join Us?**

* **Direct Strategic Impact:** Become our first dedicated BI specialist, helping select our BI platform and building the reporting foundation for retail stores in Germany and Austria, our online shop, and leadership.
* **Stable, Overlapping Schedule:** Remote work from India with consistent weekday hours (12:30–21:30 IST) that give you at least 7 hours of live overlap with our technical lead in Germany.
* **Modern Data Stack & Growth:** Work directly with a MySQL-based data warehouse aggregating POS, ERP, e-commerce, and marketing data, supported by a dedicated learning budget (e.g., for Microsoft PL-300).
* **Clean, Documented BI Function:** Build a lasting data dictionary, clear KPI definitions, and self-help guides in our Outline knowledge base.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* **BI Platform Evaluation**
* **What You Will Do:** Run a proof of concept on our real reports, compare options on licence and hosting cost, maintenance effort, performance with wide tables (50+ columns), and visual quality, and present a clear recommendation with a business case. Then set up the chosen tool.
* **Requirements & Business Partnering**
* **What You Will Do:** Work with management, marketing, finance, and stores to understand the goal behind each request (e.g., "how does ad spend on channel X change user behaviour Y?"), translate it into KPIs and data needs, and propose solutions—not just build what is written down.
* **Data Connections & Pipelines**
* **What You Will Do:** Connect our sources—our base is a MySQL-based data warehouse, with data aggregated from POS, ERP/warehouse systems, the online shop, Google Sheets, and finance files, with new sources added regularly—with scheduled refreshes and monitoring. Specify the structured data you need; our development team helps bring new sources into the warehouse.
* **Data Modelling & DAX**
* **What You Will Do:** Build star-schema models and DAX measures (contribution margin, sales, returns, stock, marketing performance) whose totals are correct at every level. Prepare the model so a move to Power BI is straightforward.
* **Data Validation & Quality**
* **What You Will Do:** Check the data you work with for duplicates, inconsistent values, returns, and gaps; reconcile figures with the source systems; set up data-quality checks and flag issues to the data team.
* **Dashboards & Reports**
* **What You Will Do:** Design fast, readable dashboards for management and stores: wide tables with frozen columns, filters by date, country, SKU, and channel, drill-down, and Excel export.
* **Maintenance & Support**

**Enterprise Data Intelligence (EDI), part of Visas Corporate Information Technology organization, brings together data, analytics, and AI capabilities to turn enterprise data into actionable insights and enable data-driven decision-making. * Apply established architectural patterns with good technical judgment
* Take ownership of code quality, testing, and production reliability
* Partner with GenAI agents for code generation, refactoring, and automated testing.
* Experiment in Visas AI sandbox, where multiple GenAI models and frameworks are available for employee-driven innovation.
* Apply Generative AI models to API integration challenges, anomaly detection, and intelligent automation.
* Collaborates actively within a crossfunctional team
* Translate functional requirements into clean, efficient, and maintainable code.

* Develop and maintain automated unit and component tests.

**Preferred Qualification:**

  

* **12 years of hands-on software engineering experience building, delivering, and supporting enterprise-grade Java/J2EE applications, preferably using Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, and modern front-end frameworks such as Angular or React.**

**About Us**    
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, youll have the opportunity to create impact at scale - tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters - to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

**Role Summary:**

  

**Enterprise Data Intelligence (EDI), part of Visa s Corporate Information Technology organization, brings together data, analytics, and AI capabilities to turn enterprise data into actionable insights and enable data-driven decision-making. EDI delivers secure, high-quality, and accessible data assets alongside reliable, scalable platforms that help Visa s business teams and partners develop innovative products and services.**

  

**Our areas of focus span Business Intelligence and Analytics, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and Platform as a Service.** With a portfolio of over 60 data products and platforms supporting internal lines of business and external clients, EDI provides the technology and processes to manage Visa s data assets and deliver valuable information and services at scale.

  

The Software Engineer would be a part of a high-performance global team responsible for the delivery of features in the Enterprise Data Intelligence (EDI) program.

  

We are seeking an Associate Software Engineer to join the Enterprise Data Intelligence (EDI) Engineering team. You will contribute to the development of next-generation AI solutions that transform Business Intelligence through Generative AI, Machine Learning, Conversational AI, and Developer Productivity tools.

  

This role is ideal for engineers who are passionate about AI technologies and eager to work on enterprise-scale solutions that directly impact customer experience and operational efficiency.

  

Every engineer in this team will work in close collaboration with Generative AI tools as development companions, leveraging Visa s extensive portfolio of AI models, tools, and experimentation platforms.

  

As a key member of the delivery execution team, candidates would need to create scalable designs, write maintainable code, reusable components/services/utilities, and test cases.

  

**Responsibilities:**

  

* Work independently on defined problems and features
* Apply established architectural patterns with good technical judgment
* Take ownership of code quality, testing, and production reliability
* Partner with GenAI agents for code generation, refactoring, and automated testing.
* Experiment in Visa s AI sandbox, where multiple GenAI models and frameworks are available for employee-driven innovation.
* Apply Generative AI models to API integration challenges, anomaly detection, and intelligent automation.
* Collaborates actively within a cross-functional team
* Translate functional requirements into clean, efficient, and maintainable code.
* Write high-quality, readable, and testable code aligned with defined engineering standards.
* Develop and maintain automated unit and component tests.
* Identify and address defects, performance issues, and reliability gaps in owned areas.
* Participate in production releases and operational readiness activities.
* Work closely with Product Managers, DevOps, and peer engineers.

  

**Visa requires at least 3 days in office,** expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**

Basic Qualifications:

* Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline, OR 3+ years of relevant work experience.

  

**Preferred Qualification:**

  

* **1-2 years of hands-on software engineering experience building, delivering, and supporting enterprise-grade Java/J2EE applications, preferably using Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, and modern front-end frameworks such as Angular or React.**
* **Hands-on experience with AI-assisted software delivery, including effective use of generative AI coding assistants and developer productivity tools such as Claude Code CLI, GitHub Copilot, Cline, or similar tools for prompt engineering, AI-supported code review, test generation, documentation, and productivity workflows.**
* Working knowledge of applied AI concepts relevant to software engineering, such as large language models, embeddings, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, model limitations, data privacy, and responsible AI practices.
* Strong foundation in software engineering principles, clean code practices, object-oriented design, data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and scalable application architecture.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and debugging skills with the ability to troubleshoot complex issues across application, integration, data, infrastructure, and AI-assisted delivery workflows.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical decisions clearly, collaborate across Product, Architecture, DevOps, QA, and Security teams, and document designs and trade-offs concisely.
* Experience in financial services, payments, or other high-volume, mission-critical enterprise platforms is a strong plus

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

As a Software Engineer, you will contribute to systems supporting licensing, entitlements, product activation, secure software downloads, ecommerce, tenant provisioning, customer and partner experiences, and integrations with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce and other Ivanti systems.

You will collaborate with experienced engineers to modernize applications, strengthen service and integration boundaries, and deliver secure, observable, and maintainable software.   
   
 **Responsibilities**   

* Designing, develop, test, deploy, and support enterprise applications and services used for licensing, entitlements, activations, secure downloads, ecommerce, customer access, and system integration.
* Building backend services using C#, .NET, and ASP.NET Core, including REST APIs, background services, integrations, and event-driven processing.
* Developing and support cloud-hosted workloads using appropriate Azure services such as Azure Functions, Azure Service Bus, Azure App Service, Azure Storage, Azure Key Vault, Azure API Management, Application Insights, and container platforms where appropriate.
* Contributing to full-stack application features using technologies such as React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Razor, HTML, and CSS when the work requires user-facing functionality.
* Integrating enterprise systems through stable APIs and asynchronous messaging, applying established patterns for validation, retries, idempotency, error handling, and failure recovery.
* Helping keep third-party platform details behind maintainable service interfaces and adapters so core business logic remains understandable and supportable.
* Contributing to incremental modernization of legacy applications and integrations, including Java, AngularJS, Ruby, Salesforce, on-premises, or tightly coupled implementations.
* Implementing secure authentication and authorization using approved patterns and technologies such as Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT bearer tokens, role-based access, managed identities, and secure secret management.
* Applying secure-development practices, including input validation, least-privilege access, dependency review, secure configuration, vulnerability remediation, and protection of credentials and sensitive data.
* Use Git and Azure DevOps to manage source code, work items, automated builds, quality checks, deployment pipelines, and release traceability.
* Using approved AI-assisted development tools for exploration, prototyping, code generation, test creation, documentation, refactoring, and review. Validate generated output and remain accountable for correctness, security, licensing, architecture alignment, and maintainability.

  
   
 **Qualifications**   

* A bachelors degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical software-development experience.

* Experience with relational databases, preferably SQL Server, Azure SQL, or Postgres including querying, data modeling, transactions, and safe data-access practices.

* Familiarity with CI/CD concepts and an ability to understand or modify build and deployment pipelines with team guidance.
* Understanding of secure application-development fundamentals, including authentication, authorization, secrets management, dependency security, and protection of sensitive configuration.
* Strong diagnostic and problem-solving skills across application code, APIs, databases, cloud configuration, and integrations.
* Ability to learn an existing codebase, make appropriately scoped changes, and improve it incrementally.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills and a collaborative, accountable working style suited to a distributed global organization.
